name: Western Europe
description: Capitals of art and ceremony, castles above river valleys and country lanes an hour from the city. Europe at its most polished, best taken slowly and by train.

name: The Mediterranean
description: Whitewashed islands, Roman stone and Ottoman domes around one warm sea. Long lunches, late light and a coastline that rewards a boat as much as a car.
countries: Turkey | Italy | Spain | Greece | Portugal | Croatia

name: Alps & Central Europe
description: Glacier trains, lakeside towns and the concert halls of Vienna. Snow on the peaks in summer and palaces in the valleys below.

name: Gulf & Arabia
description: Towers on the waterfront, desert camps under clear skies and Nabataean tombs in sandstone. A short flight from home, and the easiest place to begin a longer journey.

name: East Asia
description: Temple gardens, imperial palaces and cities that run like clockwork. Ancient and modern side by side, each season with its own reason to go.

name: Southeast Asia
description: Limestone bays, gilded temples and rice terraces, with warm water close at hand. Generous hospitality and some of the finest resorts in the world.

name: Indian Ocean
description: Private islands ringed by reef, and a teardrop island of tea hills, forts and old kingdoms. Barefoot luxury, with the ocean always in view.

name: Caucasus & Silk Road
description: Mountain monasteries, old wine country and the tiled cities of the Silk Road. Close to Pakistan, still quiet, and full of welcome.
